title: 08. Multi-Agent & Patterns: Agent-to-Agent Protocol (A2A) 1/2: What is A2A? · A2A vs MCP — Key Differences …
summary: A2A is Google's open protocol (launched April 2025) that defines how AI agents communicate, collaborate, and delegate tasks to each other — regardless of which framework, vendor, or language they're built with.

sections.title: Introduction
sections.body: **A2A** is Google's open protocol (launched April 2025) that defines **how AI agents communicate, collaborate, and delegate tasks to each other** — regardless of which framework, vendor, or language they're built with. Think of it as **HTTP for AI agents**.

sections.title: What is A2A?
sections.body:
```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   A2A PROTOCOL OVERVIEW                         │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

WITHOUT A2A:                        WITH A2A:
────────────────────────────────    ────────────────────────────────
LangChain Agent ──?──► AutoGen      LangChain Agent
LangChain Agent ──?──► SK Agent         │
AutoGen ──?──► PydanticAI               │  A2A Protocol (standard)
                                        │  (JSON-RPC over HTTP/SSE)
Every framework is incompatible!        ▼
❌ No standard communication       ┌──────────────────────────────┐
❌ Vendor lock-in                  │      ANY A2A Agent           │
❌ Can't mix frameworks            │  AutoGen | LangGraph | SK    │
                                   │  PydanticAI | Custom         │
                                   └──────────────────────────────┘

                                   ✅ Any agent talks to any agent
                                   ✅ Framework agnostic
                                   ✅ Language agnostic
                                   ✅ Vendor agnostic
```

sections.title: core/models.py — A2A Data Models
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- Complete A2A Protocol Data Models Based on Google's A2A specification (April 2025)
- Extract all text from message parts.
- Get the most recent text from messages or artifacts.
- TASK REQUESTS / RESPONSES

**Defines:** `TaskState`, `Role`, `PartType`, `TextPart`, `FilePart`, `DataPart`, `Message`, `Artifact`, `TaskStatus`, `Task`

```python name=a2a_agents/core/models.py
"""
Complete A2A Protocol Data Models
Based on Google's A2A specification (April 2025)
"""
from __future__  import annotations
from enum        import Enum
from typing      import Any, Optional, Union
from pydantic    import BaseModel, Field
from datetime    import datetime
import uuid

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ENUMS
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TaskState(str, Enum):
    SUBMITTED  = "submitted"
    WORKING    = "working"
    COMPLETED  = "completed"
    FAILED     = "failed"
    CANCELLED  = "cancelled"
    INPUT_REQUIRED = "input-required"

class Role(str, Enum):
    USER  = "user"
    AGENT = "agent"

class PartType(str, Enum):
    TEXT = "text"
    FILE = "file"
    DATA = "data"

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MESSAGE PARTS
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TextPart(BaseModel):
    type:     PartType = PartType.TEXT
    text:     str
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

class FilePart(BaseModel):
    type:      PartType = PartType.FILE
    file_name: str
    mime_type: str
    content:   str       # Base64 encoded
    metadata:  dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

class DataPart(BaseModel):
    type:     PartType = PartType.DATA
    data:     dict[str, Any]
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

Part = Union[TextPart, FilePart, DataPart]

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# MESSAGE
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class Message(BaseModel):
    role:     Role
    parts:    list[Part]
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

    @classmethod
    def user_text(cls, text: str) -> "Message":
        return cls(role=Role.USER, parts=[TextPart(text=text)])

    @classmethod
    def agent_text(cls, text: str) -> "Message":
        return cls(role=Role.AGENT, parts=[TextPart(text=text)])

    @classmethod
    def agent_data(cls, data: dict) -> "Message":
        return cls(role=Role.AGENT, parts=[DataPart(data=data)])

    def get_text(self) -> str:
        """Extract all text from message parts."""
        parts = []
        for part in self.parts:
            if isinstance(part, TextPart):
                parts.append(part.text)
            elif isinstance(part, DataPart):
                import json
                parts.append(json.dumps(part.data))
        return "\n".join(parts)

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# ARTIFACT
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class Artifact(BaseModel):
    artifact_id: str        = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4())[:8])
    name:        str
    description: str        = ""
    parts:       list[Part]
    metadata:    dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    index:       int            = 0
    append:      bool           = False
    last_chunk:  bool           = True

    @classmethod
    def text(cls, name: str, content: str) -> "Artifact":
        return cls(name=name, parts=[TextPart(text=content)])

    @classmethod
    def data(cls, name: str, data: dict) -> "Artifact":
        return cls(name=name, parts=[DataPart(data=data)])

    def get_text(self) -> str:
        for part in self.parts:
            if isinstance(part, TextPart):
                return part.text
        return ""

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TASK
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TaskStatus(BaseModel):
    state:     TaskState
    message:   Optional[Message] = None
    timestamp: str = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    )

class Task(BaseModel):
    id:          str            = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    session_id:  Optional[str]  = None
    status:      TaskStatus
    messages:    list[Message]  = Field(default_factory=list)
    artifacts:   list[Artifact] = Field(default_factory=list)
    metadata:    dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)
    created_at:  str            = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
    )

    def get_last_text(self) -> str:
        """Get the most recent text from messages or artifacts."""
        # Check artifacts first
        if self.artifacts:
            text = self.artifacts[-1].get_text()
            if text:
                return text
        # Then messages
        for msg in reversed(self.messages):
            text = msg.get_text()
            if text:
                return text
        return ""

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# TASK REQUESTS / RESPONSES
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class TaskSendParams(BaseModel):
    id:          Optional[str]  = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4()))
    session_id:  Optional[str]  = None
    message:     Message
    metadata:    dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)

class TaskGetParams(BaseModel):
    id:            str
    history_length: Optional[int] = None

class TaskCancelParams(BaseModel):
    id: str

class A2ARequest(BaseModel):
    jsonrpc: str              = "2.0"
    id:      Union[str, int]  = Field(default_factory=lambda: str(uuid.uuid4())[:8])
    method:  str
    params:  dict[str, Any]   = Field(default_factory=dict)

class A2AResponse(BaseModel):
    jsonrpc: str              = "2.0"
    id:      Union[str, int]  = ""
    result:  Optional[Any]    = None
    error:   Optional[dict]   = None

# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# AGENT CARD
# ════════════════════════════════════════════════════

class AgentSkill(BaseModel):
    id:           str
    name:         str
    description:  str
    tags:         list[str]           = Field(default_factory=list)
    examples:     list[str]           = Field(default_factory=list)
    input_modes:  list[str]           = ["text"]
    output_modes: list[str]           = ["text"]

class AgentCapabilities(BaseModel):
    streaming:           bool = True
    push_notifications:  bool = False
    state_transition_history: bool = True

class AgentCard(BaseModel):
    name:             str
    description:      str
    url:              str
    version:          str               = "1.0.0"
    capabilities:     AgentCapabilities = Field(default_factory=AgentCapabilities)
    skills:           list[AgentSkill]  = Field(default_factory=list)
    default_input_modes:  list[str]     = ["text"]
    default_output_modes: list[str]     = ["text"]
    metadata:         dict[str, Any]    = Field(default_factory=dict)
```

sections.title: core/server.py — Base A2A Server
core/client.py — Base A2A Client
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- A2A Client — connects to any A2A agent server
- Generic A2A client that can connect to any A2A agent.
- Fetch agent card from /.well-known/agent.json
- Send a task and wait for completion.

```python name=a2a_agents/core/client.py
"""
A2A Client — connects to any A2A agent server
"""
import json
import httpx
import asyncio
from typing    import AsyncGenerator, Optional
from core.models import (
    AgentCard, Task, TaskState,
    A2ARequest, Message, TaskSendParams,
)

class A2AClient:
    """
    Generic A2A client that can connect to any A2A agent.
    Handles: agent card discovery, task sending, streaming.
    """

    def __init__(self, agent_url: str, timeout: float = 60.0):
        self.url     = agent_url.rstrip("/")
        self.timeout = timeout
        self.card:   Optional[AgentCard] = None
        self._client = httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=self.timeout)

    # ── Discovery ─────────────────────────────────
    async def discover(self) -> AgentCard:
        """Fetch agent card from /.well-known/agent.json"""
        resp      = await self._client.get(f"{self.url}/.well-known/agent.json")
        resp.raise_for_status()
        self.card = AgentCard(**resp.json())
        return self.card

    # ── Task Sending ──────────────────────────────
    async def send_task(
        self,
        message:    str,
        session_id: Optional[str] = None,
        metadata:   dict = None,
    ) -> Task:
        """Send a task and wait for completion."""
        params = TaskSendParams(
            message    = Message.user_text(message),
            session_id = session_id,
            metadata   = metadata or {},
        )
        req = A2ARequest(
            method = "tasks/send",
            params = params.model_dump(),
        )
        resp = await self._client.post(
            f"{self.url}/a2a",
            json    = req.model_dump(),
            headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        resp.raise_for_status()
        data   = resp.json()
        task   = Task(**data["result"])

        # Poll until complete
        task = await self._wait_for_completion(task.id)
        return task

    async def _wait_for_completion(
        self,
        task_id: str,
        poll_interval: float = 0.5,
        max_wait:      float = 120.0,
    ) -> Task:
        """Poll task status until completed/failed."""
        elapsed = 0.0
        while elapsed < max_wait:
            req  = A2ARequest(
                method = "tasks/get",
                params = {"id": task_id},
            )
            resp = await self._client.post(
                f"{self.url}/a2a",
                json = req.model_dump(),
            )
            resp.raise_for_status()
            task = Task(**resp.json()["result"])

            if task.status.state in [
                TaskState.COMPLETED,
                TaskState.FAILED,
                TaskState.CANCELLED,
            ]:
                return task

            await asyncio.sleep(poll_interval)
            elapsed += poll_interval

        raise TimeoutError(f"Task {task_id} timed out after {max_wait}s")

    async def stream_task(
        self,
        message: str,
    ) -> AsyncGenerator[dict, None]:
        """Send task and stream results via SSE."""
        # Send with subscribe
        params = TaskSendParams(message=Message.user_text(message))
        req    = A2ARequest(
            method = "tasks/sendSubscribe",
            params = params.model_dump(),
        )
        resp   = await self._client.post(
            f"{self.url}/a2a", json=req.model_dump()
        )
        result = resp.json()["result"]
        task_id    = result["id"]
        stream_url = result.get("stream_url",
                                f"{self.url}/a2a/stream/{task_id}")

        # Stream SSE events
        async with self._client.stream("GET", stream_url) as stream:
            async for line in stream.aiter_lines():
                if line.startswith("data:"):
                    data_str = line[5:].strip()
                    if data_str:
                        yield json.loads(data_str)

    async def get_capabilities(self) -> list[str]:
        """Returns list of skills/capabilities."""
        if not self.card:
            await self.discover()
        return [s.name for s in self.card.skills]

    async def close(self):
        await self._client.aclose()

    async def __aenter__(self): return self
    async def __aexit__(self, *args): await self.close()
```

sections.title: Agent 1: Orchestrator (Azure OpenAI)
sections.body:
**What this code covers**

- A2A Orchestrator Agent — Azure OpenAI Master agent that decomposes tasks and delegates to specialists.
- Discover all specialist agents via A2A.
- Use LLM to plan which agents to delegate to.
- You are a task planner.
- Step 1: Discover agents
- Step 2: Plan delegation
- Step 3: Execute subtasks (respecting dependencies)

```python name=a2a_agents/agents/orchestrator_agent.py
"""
A2A Orchestrator Agent — Azure OpenAI
Master agent that decomposes tasks and delegates to specialists.
Runs on port 8000.
"""
import os
import json
import asyncio
from typing        import AsyncGenerator
from dotenv        import load_dotenv
from openai        import AzureOpenAI

from core.models   import (
    AgentCard, AgentSkill, AgentCapabilities,
    Task, TaskStatus, TaskState, Artifact, Message,
)
from core.server   import BaseA2AAgent
from core.client   import A2AClient

load_dotenv()

az_client  = AzureOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key        = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version    = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
)
DEPLOYMENT = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT")

# ── Specialist Agent Registry ─────────────────────
SPECIALIST_AGENTS = {
    "research": "http://localhost:8001",
    "code":     "http://localhost:8002",
    "math":     "http://localhost:8003",
    "writer":   "http://localhost:8004",
    "critic":   "http://localhost:8005",
}

class OrchestratorAgent(BaseA2AAgent):

    def __init__(self):
        card = AgentCard(
            name        = "OrchestratorAgent",
            description = "Master orchestrator that decomposes complex tasks and delegates to specialist agents via A2A protocol.",
            url         = "http://localhost:8000",
            version     = "1.0.0",
            capabilities = AgentCapabilities(streaming=True),
            skills       = [
                AgentSkill(
                    id          = "orchestrate",
                    name        = "Task Orchestration",
                    description = "Decompose and delegate complex tasks",
                    tags        = ["orchestration", "planning", "delegation"],
                    examples    = ["Research AI trends and write a report",
                                   "Analyze data and create visualizations"],
                ),
                AgentSkill(
                    id          = "discover",
                    name        = "Agent Discovery",
                    description = "Discover and connect to other A2A agents",
                    tags        = ["discovery", "a2a"],
                ),
            ],
        )
        super().__init__(card)
        self._agent_cards: dict[str, AgentCard] = {}

    async def _discover_agents(self):
        """Discover all specialist agents via A2A."""
        for name, url in SPECIALIST_AGENTS.items():
            try:
                async with A2AClient(url) as client:
                    card = await client.discover()
                    self._agent_cards[name] = card
                    print(f"  ✅ Discovered: {card.name} @ {url}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ⚠️  Could not discover {name} @ {url}: {e}")

    async def _plan_delegation(self, task_text: str) -> list[dict]:
        """Use LLM to plan which agents to delegate to."""
        available = list(self._agent_cards.keys()) or list(SPECIALIST_AGENTS.keys())

        response = az_client.chat.completions.create(
            model    = DEPLOYMENT,
            messages = [
                {"role": "system", "content": f"""
You are a task planner. Break the task into subtasks and assign to agents.
Available agents: {available}
Return JSON array ONLY:
[{{"agent": "research", "subtask": "...", "depends_on": []}}]
"""},
                {"role": "user", "content": f"Task: {task_text}"},
            ],
            temperature = 0.0,
            max_tokens  = 500,
        )

        raw = response.choices[0].message.content.strip()
        try:
            import re
            match = re.search(r'\[.*\]', raw, re.DOTALL)
            return json.loads(match.group()) if match else [
                {"agent": "research", "subtask": task_text, "depends_on": []}
            ]
        except:
            return [{"agent": "research", "subtask": task_text, "depends_on": []}]

    async def _delegate_to_agent(
        self, agent_name: str, subtask: str
    ) -> str:
        """Delegate a subtask to a specialist via A2A."""
        url = SPECIALIST_AGENTS.get(agent_name, "http://localhost:8001")
        try:
            async with A2AClient(url) as client:
                print(f"    🤝 A2A → {agent_name} @ {url}")
                task = await client.send_task(subtask)
                result = task.get_last_text()
                print(f"    ✅ {agent_name} completed")
                return result
        except Exception as e:
            return f"Agent {agent_name} unavailable: {e}"

    async def _synthesize(self, original: str, results: dict) -> str:
        """Synthesize all agent results into final answer."""
        context = "\n\n".join([
            f"[{agent.upper()}]: {result}"
            for agent, result in results.items()
        ])
        response = az_client.chat.completions.create(
            model    = DEPLOYMENT,
            messages = [
                {"role": "system", "content":
                    "Synthesize agent results into one complete answer."},
                {"role": "user", "content":
                    f"Original task: {original}\n\nAgent Results:\n{context}"},
            ],
            temperature = 0.3,
            max_tokens  = 800,
        )
        return response.choices[0].message.content.strip()

    async def process_task(self, task: Task) -> AsyncGenerator:
        """Main orchestration logic."""
        query = task.messages[-1].get_text()
        print(f"\n🎯 Orchestrator processing: '{query[:60]}'")

        # Step 1: Discover agents
        yield TaskStatus(state=TaskState.WORKING,
                         message=Message.agent_text("Discovering specialist agents..."))
        await self._discover_agents()

        # Step 2: Plan delegation
        yield TaskStatus(state=TaskState.WORKING,
                         message=Message.agent_text("Planning task delegation..."))
        plan = await self._plan_delegation(query)
        print(f"  📋 Plan: {[(p['agent'], p['subtask'][:40]) for p in plan]}")

        yield Artifact.text("plan", json.dumps(plan, indent=2))

        # Step 3: Execute subtasks (respecting dependencies)
        results    = {}
        completed  = set()

        for step in plan:
            agent   = step["agent"]
            subtask = step["subtask"]
            deps    = step.get("depends_on", [])

            # Resolve dependency placeholders
            for dep_idx in deps:
                if str(dep_idx) in results:
                    subtask = subtask.replace(
                        f"{{result_{dep_idx}}}", results[str(dep_idx)]
                    )

            yield TaskStatus(state=TaskState.WORKING,
                             message=Message.agent_text(f"Delegating to {agent}..."))

            result = await self._delegate_to_agent(agent, subtask)
            results[agent] = result
            completed.add(agent)

            yield Artifact.text(f"result_{agent}", result)

        # Step 4: Synthesize
        yield TaskStatus(state=TaskState.WORKING,
                         message=Message.agent_text("Synthesizing results..."))
        final = await self._synthesize(query, results)

        yield Artifact.text("final_answer", final)
        yield TaskStatus(state=TaskState.COMPLETED)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    agent = OrchestratorAgent()
    agent.run(port=8000)
```

sections.title: Agent 2: Research Agent (LangChain)
sections.body:
```python name=a2a_agents/agents/research_agent.py
"""
A2A Research Agent — LangChain
Specialist agent for research tasks. Runs on port 8001.
"""
import os
from typing           import AsyncGenerator
from dotenv           import load_dotenv
from langchain_openai  import AzureChatOpenAI
from langchain_core.messages import HumanMessage
from langchain_core.output_parsers import StrOutputParser
from langchain_core.prompts import ChatPromptTemplate

from core.models import (
    AgentCard, AgentSkill, AgentCapabilities,
    Task, TaskStatus, TaskState, Artifact, Message,
)
from core.server import BaseA2AAgent

load_dotenv()

llm = AzureChatOpenAI(
    azure_endpoint   = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT"),
    api_key          = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY"),
    api_version      = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_API_VERSION"),
    azure_deployment = os.getenv("AZURE_OPENAI_DEPLOYMENT"),
    temperature      = 0.2,
)

# LangChain LCEL research chain
research_chain = (
    ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
        ("system", """You are an expert research specialist.
Provide comprehensive, well-structured research findings.
Always include: Overview, Key Facts, Current State, and Implications."""),
        ("human", "Research this topic thoroughly: {topic}"),
    ])
    | llm
    | StrOutputParser()
)

summarize_chain = (
    ChatPromptTemplate.from_messages([
        ("system", "Summarize research findings concisely in bullet points."),
        ("human", "Research: {research}\n\nProvide bullet-point summary:"),
    ])
    | llm
    | StrOutputParser()
)

class ResearchAgent(BaseA2AAgent):

    def __init__(self):
        card = AgentCard(
            name        = "ResearchAgent",
            description = "LangChain-powered research specialist. Finds facts, summaries, and insights on any topic.",
            url         = "http://localhost:8001",
            capabilities = AgentCapabilities(streaming=True),
            skills       = [
                AgentSkill(
                    id          = "research",
                    name        = "Deep Research",
                    description = "Research any topic comprehensively",
                    tags        = ["research", "facts", "information"],
                    examples    = ["Research AI trends", "Find facts about quantum computing"],
                ),
                AgentSkill(
                    id          = "summarize",
                    name        = "Summarization",
                    description = "Summarize long content",
                    tags        = ["summarize", "condense"],
                ),
            ],
        )
        super().__init__(card)

    async def process_task(self, task: Task) -> AsyncGenerator:
        query = task.messages[-1].get_text()
        print(f"  🔬 ResearchAgent: '{query[:60]}'")

        yield TaskStatus(
            state   = TaskState.WORKING,
            message = Message.agent_text("Researching...")
        )

        # Step 1: Deep research via LangChain
        research = await research_chain.ainvoke({"topic": query})
        yield Artifact.text("research_findings", research)

        # Step 2: Summarize
        summary = await summarize_chain.ainvoke({"research": research})
        yield Artifact.text("summary", summary)

        yield TaskStatus(state=TaskState.COMPLETED)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    ResearchAgent().run(port=8001)
```
